newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: N. Korean defector said to arrive in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: N. Korean defector said to arrive in Philippines.

text.p: North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop was among four passengers who arrived at the Philippines' Clark airbase on Tuesday after a flight from Xiamen, China, a senior military officer said.

The officer, who asked not to be identified, said a helicopter immediately flew Hwang and his companions to the northern mountain resort city of Baguio. Officials were not immediately availble to confirm the report.
The officer confirmed Hwang, a top North Korean ideologue and the most senior official to defect from the Stalinist homeland, was one of the four passengers.
He did not know the identities of the three other passengers.
The Boeing landed at Clark airbase at 12:23 p.m. (0423 gmt) and left at 1:27 p.m. (0527) for an unknown destination, the source said.
Alger Ramo, supervising air traffic controller at the Manila international airport, said the plane sought airport clearance only minutes before it landed at Clark, 80 km (50 miles) north of Manila.
